section.name: EBApplicability20261008
section.heading: End-bent model reconciliation — 8 October 2026 (model sources superseded by the 19 October 2026 record below)
section.paragraph: Both end bents follow the controlling End Bent 1 configuration by user direction. The user confirms the cap report contains the latest FBMP model; loaded nodes are 15 and 34 after model refinement. Shared square-pile geometry and the separate 30-in end-bent pedestal are recorded in Bridge Geometry. The p-multiplier discussion below remains for pier pipe piles. The different same-named Downloads XML is not the source model. This update does not rerun FBMP or verify raw input loads absent from the report; backwall and cheek-wall quantities remain deferred.

section.name: ModelSources20261019
section.heading: Current model sources — 19 October 2026
section.paragraph: Current FB-MultiPier models are the 19 October 2026 fixed-run exports selected under D-049 (FB-MultiPier 6.1.0): End Bent 1_Fixed.XML (SHA-256 c1a4afa138865b3f10cc968ce7daef767a4d96e8bc2ccf175c1a5ebd150d912d), End Bent 2_Fixed.XML (SHA-256 3543df298b92593ce9bac14f9228ffacf5b0ce7e76b5e1d887ae228ef811a90e) and Pier_Fixed.XML (SHA-256 bb73e6ada6cf35ebb80b512cee315075807fc8ccab7878406d81ff381ae40fe7), held in project_current/fbmp/. The 19 October cap reports and cases (D-051: CapDesignEndBentOne, CapDesignEndBentTwo, CapDesignPier) and pile reports (D-054: PileDesignEndBentOne, PileDesignEndBentTwo, PileDesignPier) read these exports.

End-bent models: 251-in cap (the cage envelope with the 8-in cheek webs), 42 x 36 in, four 18-in square prestressed piles at 54-in centers, first pile center 44.5 in from each cap end (36.5 in from the 235-in cap-body end recorded in Bridge Geometry); loaded nodes 15 and 34 carry the DC, LL, IM, BR and PL node loads. Pier model: 230-in cap, 48 x 36 in, four 20-in x 0.48-in steel pipe piles at 60-in centers, bearing rows at Y = -10.50 and +10.50 in. Pile cutoff and ground elevations in the pile reports come from these exports.

Currency of these models against the current journal loads (haunch weights with the notebook cambers, wind heights, backwall and cheek geometry of D-053/D-055) is not asserted; FBMP was not rerun for this record. The 16 October 2026 backwall report (D-037) predates these exports and the D-053 geometry and is not in the journal.

section.name: EqNotes_PedBridge_058_B_pMult
section.paragraph: This input is the width or diameter represented by B in the spacing comparisons. It follows the same current 20-in project diameter as the pipe-section calculation.

report.paragraph: Physical spacing equal to 5 selected pile widths.

section.name: EqNotes_PedBridge_059_5_B_pMult
section.paragraph:
Multiply
B_pMult
, the pile width entered for the spacing discussion, by 5. This converts a spacing stated as a number of pile widths into a distance. Compare it with the actual center spacing; this expression does not calculate a group-reduction factor.

section.name: EqNotes_PedBridge_061_S_B
section.paragraph:
Divide
BridgeGeometry_2Beam.Pile_spacing
, the center-to-center spacing, by
B_pMult

section.name: PierSourceReconciliation
section.heading: Current pier model source — 9 October 2026
section.paragraph: The replacement Pier Cap Design 10-9.html identifies Pier_Fixed.XML, SHA-256 a992aa331e11b4eb9bc426a3f811938a8f71b22b3300bae3431eb2931eaff9d8. The reported cap layout remains 48 × 36 × 230 in, with four 20-in pipes at 60-in centers. The matching raw XML (D-049, 19 October 2026) now confirms symmetric ±10.50-in bearing rows. The prior Pier_MinTip mapping is retained only as historical evidence. Full journal/model load-input currency and structural adequacy remain outside this source-record acceptance; no FBMP rerun is claimed.
